summary: Minimal, targeted fix: adds `and not rep.skipped` guard so --runxfail's early-return no longer bypasses the skip-location rewriting logic below, matching the reported bug exactly. Change is a one-condition tweak that doesn't alter xfail handling in any other case.

issues.description: Comment change ('don't interfere with xfail') is fine but the branch now has two responsibilities (runxfail passthrough excluding skips) that could use a slightly clearer comment explaining why skipped reports are excluded.
